hero.selo: Curriculum for People Working in Technology
hero.titulo: From your resume to a plan that
hero.sub: Submit your resume and tell us where you want to go. PathR builds your learning path in phases, selects the right material for each module, assesses what you’ve actually learned, and adjusts your path based on your progress.
hero.janelaDescricao: Dashboard showing study sequence, plan progress, and time spent studying
hero.dica: Hover your mouse over the cards—and select modules on the track below to see your progress increase here.

comoFunciona.titulo: Three steps, and the plan works for you

curriculo.texto: The AI analyzes your skills and the proficiency level of each one. No need to manually fill out a list of 200 technologies.

trilha.texto: Phases and modules organized according to your goals and the number of hours you have available each week.

ajuste.texto: Quizzes, explanations in your own words, and spaced repetition will boost your skill level. The week falls into place on its own.

trilha.titulo: A progress bar that shows how much is left
trilha.texto: Each module includes the right material—an article, video, documentation, or guided example—and the time it takes to complete. Check off what you've finished and watch your progress grow.
trilha.ponto1: Order as required by your objective
trilha.ponto2: Time per module based on the length of your week
trilha.ponto3: With this phase complete, the next one takes it a step further
trilha.janelaDescricao: Modules in the current phase that can be marked as completed

constancia.titulo: A map of the year showing what you studied each day
constancia.texto: Each square represents a day. Hover your mouse over it to see what was done—the article, the video, the quiz—and how long it took. Switch between week, month, and year.
constancia.ponto1: Sequence and record that you protect
constancia.ponto2: Study time measured by what was read and watched
constancia.ponto3: Week, month, and year on the same dashboard
constancia.janelaDescricao: Annual heat map showing school days

codigo.titulo: Ready-made examples, explained line by line
codigo.texto: Choose the language and topic. PathR writes a short program and shows what each line does—without requiring you to install any software to understand the concept.
codigo.ponto1: The languages listed on your profile, with the logo for each one
codigo.ponto2: A step-by-step breakdown of what happens during execution
codigo.ponto3: Suggestions based on the module you're studying
codigo.janelaDescricao: Example generator with language selection and line-by-line explanations

idiomas.titulo: English for Work, at Your Actual Level
idiomas.texto: A CEFR level that adapts to your answers. Stuck on a word? Tap it: the translation and synonyms will appear, and the word will be added to your review list.
idiomas.ponto1: Adaptive Placement, from A1 to C2
idiomas.ponto2: A word lookup that turns into spaced repetition
idiomas.ponto3: Daily reading, listening, and writing practice
idiomas.janelaDescricao: Leveling question involving the translation of a looked-up word

pessoas.titulo: Study with people who are close to you and want to reach the same goal
pessoas.texto: PathR suggests accounts from your city and from people studying the same technologies. Each card shows their goal, tech stack, and what you have in common—never an email address.
pessoas.ponto2: Suggestions by city, stack, and goal
pessoas.ponto3: Whether you appear in the suggestions is up to you
pessoas.janelaDescricao: Profile cards of suggested people, including their city, role, and technologies
